_note: Web hosts whose documents are treated as published by a public body. A document whose source_url is on one of these hosts is downloaded again and compared with its sha256: by CI when its manifest entry is added (tools/check_sources.py), and by the daily archive job before it uploads an external blob. A document from any other host is still welcome; it is handled as having no public source to check against. Any contributor with write access may add a host, naming the public body it belongs to. subdomains: true also matches every host ending in .<host>.
